ha_attributes.title: 12.2 Upgrade Analyzer
ha_attributes.whats_new:
The Upgrade analyzer evaluates your E-Business suite upgrade environment to be sure that all pre-upgrade/upgrade/post upgrade requirements have been properly met so that you will experience a smooth upgrade process.

Benefits

  • Immediate analysis and output of your E-Business Suite Upgrade data and progress from a particular environment
  • Evaluates E-Business Upgrade system data, setup and configurations based on the steps in the Release notes Doc ID 1320300.1 as well as the main upgrade guide Oracle® E-Business Suite Upgrade Guide Release 12.0 and 12.1 to 12.2
  • Provides recommended actions, displays potential errors or missed steps based on the progress of your 12.2 upgrade.
  • Runs as a standalone java program.
